description: This file contains integration tests for Staff functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It uses JUnit 5 to test creating, fetching, updating, and listing staff members via REST API calls, along with validation error scenarios.

classes.name: StaffTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Staff-related API endpoints in the Fineract project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configuration and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: testStaffCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new staff member.

methods.name: testStaffCreateValidationError
methods.description: Checks validation errors when creating staff with invalid JSON payloads.

methods.name: testStaffCreateMaxNameLength
methods.description: Tests creation of staff with maximum allowed name length.

methods.name: testStaffCreateExternalIdValidationError
methods.description: Validates error handling for an excessively long external ID.

methods.name: testStaffFetch
methods.description: Tests fetching a staff record by ID.

methods.name: testStaffListStatusActive
methods.description: Tests listing only active staff members.

methods.name: testStaffListStatusInactive
methods.description: Tests listing only inactive staff members.

methods.name: testStaffListFetchWrongState
methods.description: Ensures invalid state parameter results in class cast exception.

methods.name: testStaffFetchNotFound
methods.description: Checks fetching a non-existent staff member returns not found error.

methods.name: testStaffUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a staff member's details.

methods.name: testStaffUpdateLongExternalIdError
methods.description: Validates error handling for long external ID during update.

methods.name: testStaffUpdateWrongActiveState
methods.description: Checks validation error when setting invalid active state.

methods.name: testStaffUpdateNotFoundError
methods.description: Tests updating a non-existent staff member.

methods.name: testStaffUpdateValidationError
methods.description: Checks validation errors for long names and mobile numbers on update.

methods.name: testStaffLoanOfficer
methods.description: Tests creating a staff member as a loan officer and listing staff with loan officer status.
